question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Carbon accounting, supply chains, human rights, now AI customer data.
beat.headline: END-TO-END
beat.action: The previous chip is covered as the taped block unfolds into a paper conveyor that runs from one edge to the other and stops.

sources: Following acquisitions of Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, and the transformative addition of Resulticks, Diginex is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform spanning carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain transparency, human rights due diligence, and now AI-driven customer data capabilities — designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: the taped block; a paper conveyor.
Opens on the taped block, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the taped block unfolds into a paper conveyor that runs from one edge to the other and stops.
Ends holding on the conveyor.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "END-TO-END".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "END-TO-END". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Carbon accounting, supply chains, human rights, now AI customer data.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage shot in a 2D motion design style, photographed flat under soft room light from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, where a pale cyan, single unbroken block-colour paper ground fills the frame. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip with a rough edge features the headline "4 BUSINESSES" in an extra-bold black sans-serif typeface. In the lower two-thirds, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a folder-like block is held down by pieces of semi-transparent matte tape; the cutout has distinct, rough white torn-paper edges and casts a small, soft shadow to the bottom right. At 00:00.000, the action begins immediately: a new cream paper chip slides in from the top to cover the "4 BUSINESSES" headline, revealing the new stable headline "END-TO-END" in clean, bold black sans-serif typography. Simultaneously, the taped block in the center unfolds with a fast, snappy motion and a slight overshoot, transforming into a long, flat paper conveyor belt cutout that stretches horizontally from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. This conveyor belt is a black-and-white halftone photograph with rough white torn edges and no markings or text on its surface. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout. By 00:03.000, the conveyor belt comes to a complete stop, and the composition holds its clear reading window. The entire scene maintains a matte printed paper texture with visible print dots and soft shadows, with no glow or neon effects. A subtle, small loop of the conveyor's movement continues until the end of the 5-second duration. (S1), a male narrator with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk, professional speaking rate, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Carbon accounting, supply chains, human rights, now AI customer data.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the crisp, physical sounds of paper manipulation. Audible effects include a sharp, tactile paper-slap as the headline chip lands and the rhythmic, sticky sound of tape being peeled or pressed as the block unfolds into the conveyor.
